n02.roman: Ek taraf baithe hain duniya ki sabse qeemti company ke maalik — NVIDIA ke CEO, Jensen Huang.

n03.roman: Aur unke bagal mein — Alice Huang. Koi rishtedaar nahi. Unki company, NVIDIA ki badi customer hai.

n04.roman: Lekin kuch door, American agents tasveerein le rahe hain.

n05.roman: Kyunki American khufiya agencies ke mutabiq, ye aurat China ke liye kaam karti hai.

n06.roman: Aur Jensen? Unhein kuch pata nahi.

n07.roman: Ye kahaani hai us aadmi ki, jisne toilet saaf karne se shuruaat ki… aur kaise, reports ke mutabiq, China ne uski mez tak apni jasoos pahuncha di.

n08.roman: Kahaani shuru hoti hai Taiwan se. Nau saal ka Jensen aur uska bada bhai, akele America bheje gaye.

n09.roman: Chacha ne socha, Kentucky ka ye boarding school bahut achha hai. Nikla… bigde bachon ka sudhaar-ghar.

n10.roman: Bhai ko tambaaku ke kheton mein kaam mila. Aur Jensen ko? Roz toilet saaf karne ka.

n11.roman: Uska roommate satrah saal ka tha. Tattoo aur chaaku ke nishaanon se bhara… aur padhna nahi jaanta tha.

n12.roman: Jensen ne use padhna sikhaaya. Badle mein, usne Jensen ko bench press sikhaayi.

n13.roman: Pandrah saal ki umr mein, Denny's naam ke diner mein raat ki shift. Pehle bartan dhoye, phir mezein saaf kin, phir waiter bana.

n14.roman: Aur 1993 mein, usi Denny's ke ek kone waale booth mein, Jensen aur do engineer doston ne ek company banaayi — NVIDIA.

n15.roman: Shuruaati poonji? Har dost ke do sau dollar. Kul chhe sau.

n16.roman: Ab samajhiye NVIDIA ka jaadu. Aam computer chip ek ustaad baawarchi hai — jo poori baaraat ka khaana akele, ek-ek plate karke banaata hai.

n17.roman: NVIDIA ki chip? Das hazaar chhote baawarchi. Har ek, ek hi pal mein, ek roti palatta hai.

n18.roman: Video games ke liye ye kamaal tha. Phir pata chala — AI ko bhi bilkul yahi chahiye: karodon chhote hisaab, ek saath.

n19.roman: 29 October 2025. NVIDIA duniya ki pehli company bani, jiski qeemat 5 trillion dollar pahunchi.

n20.roman: Toilet saaf karne waala bachcha, ab AI ki chaabi ka maalik tha.

n21.roman: Lekin 2022 mein, Washington se phone aaya.

d02.roman: Aapki sabse taaqatwar AI chips, ab China ko nahi bechi ja saktin.

n22.roman: Paabandiyaan badhti gayin. Jensen ne khud kaha — China mein hamaara hissa 95 percent se girkar zero ho gaya.

n23.roman: China chips khareed nahi sakta tha. Lekin ek raasta tha — kiraaya.

n24.roman: Sochiye, aapko gaadi khareedne ki ijaazat nahi. To padosi gaadiyaan khareed kar border ke us paar khadi kar de… aur aap ghante ke hisaab se chaabi kiraaye par le lein.

n25.roman: 2023 mein, ek Chini gaming company se alag hokar, Singapore mein ek company bani — Megaspeed. Aur iski managing director thin — Alice Huang.

n26.roman: June 2024. Taipei ki ek bar. Jensen apne bade Asian customers ke saath jashn mana rahe hain. Aur unke theek bagal mein — Alice.

d04.roman: Welcome! Kya bana rahi hain aap?

n27.roman: Agle ek saal mein, Megaspeed ki Malaysian company ne lagbhag 2 arab dollar ki NVIDIA chips khareedin — zyaadatar ek aisi American company se, jiski Chini parent company blacklist par hai.

n28.roman: Chips gayin Malaysia aur Indonesia ke data centers mein — jo, reports ke mutabiq, door baithe Chini customers ko service de rahe the.

n29.roman: 2024 ke aakhir mein, American inspector Malaysia ke ek data center pahunche.

n30.roman: Arabon dollar ke server — ab tak dibbon mein band. Jaanch shuru hui… aur baad mein maamla America ke Justice Department tak pahuncha.

n31.roman: New York Times ke mutabiq, do saalon mein Megaspeed ne 4.8 arab dollar se zyaada ki NVIDIA chips khareedin.

n32.roman: Aur yahin kahaani palatti hai. American intelligence, Alice ki baatein sun rahi thi.

d09.roman: Wo ek American se baat kar rahi hai.

n33.roman: 2026 mein, ek khufiya memo bana. Reports ke mutabiq usmein likha tha: China ki khufiya agency MSS ne Alice ko bharti kiya — Jensen ke baare mein jaankaari jutaane ke liye.

n34.roman: Aur taaki Jensen, Washington mein, chips par paabandiyaan dheeli karwaane ki wakaalat karte rahein.

n35.roman: Reports kehti hain, President ko bhi brief kiya gaya. Lekin Jensen ko, aisa lagta hai, kisi ne nahi bataaya.

n36.roman: 29 October ko New York Times ne ye kahaani chhaap di. China ne ise bebuniyaad atkalein kaha. NVIDIA ne kaha: customers ko national security se judi zero jaankaari milti hai.

n37.roman: Phir 8 November ko, Jensen ne apne staff ko ek khat likha.

n38.roman: "Maine apni patni ke saath bewafaai ki. Mere kaamon se unhein aur hamaare bachchon ko dukh pahuncha. Iska koi bahaana nahi."

n39.roman: NVIDIA ke board ne independent jaanch shuru kar di hai. Aur American saansadon ne unhein 18 November ko band-kamre ki briefing ke liye bulaaya hai.

n40.roman: Aur dhyaan rahe — ab tak public taur par ye saabit nahi hua ki koi raaz leak hua. Jensen aaj bhi CEO hain.

n41.roman: Us dinner table par lautiye. Mombattiyaan, jaam, dosti ke naam… Jensen ke bagal ki kursi ab khaali hai.

n42.roman: Sawaal ye hai — agar America ko sab pata tha, to Jensen ko kyun nahi bataaya? Aapki kya raay hai? Comment mein zaroor bataaiye.
